cleanupPending.description: The superseded source chat is queued for secure background erasure. The returned chat is ready to use.

Environment.description: Controller-owned VM state. An exported source remains fenced. Guest disk rollback does not roll back external Internet effects.

CredentialEnvelope.description: RSA-OAEP-SHA256/MGF1-SHA256 wraps a fresh AES-256-GCM key. AAD is UTF-8(uploadId + newline + workspaceId). Encrypted payload: label, origin, username, password, lifetime (session/hours), hours (1-168 when timed). Never submit plaintext fields.

origin.description: Approved HTTPS origin. Related sign-in subdomains in the same PSL registrable domain and port are included; private tenants stay separate.

site.description: Registered website matched using the ICANN and PRIVATE Public Suffix List; null means exact-origin scope.

post.summary: Delete only one message, preserving later messages
post.description: Requires a terminal source chat. Returns an independent replacement chat immediately, with a new chat ID and the original title. The source is hidden and durably queued for seven-pass cleanup in the background. The response message ID addresses the complete saved assistant reply. Does not undo external actions. Queued follow-ups are removed. Use the returned chat ID for subsequent requests; retry the same submissionId to retrieve the same replacement.

409.description: Active work or pending cleanup; retry the same request

post.summary: Regenerate a turn from its original prompt and attachments
post.description: Requires a terminal source chat. Saves the selected prompt's context and a new response branch, dispatches generation, then finalizes retained transcript and artifact history in the background. The original response and its later conversation remain selectable in the same logical chat. Confirmation is optional for older clients. Commands may run again. Use the returned physical chat ID and reset event replay when changing versions. Retry with the same submissionId to retrieve the same generation; retries and restart recovery never implicitly reexecute it.

Future turns import retained messages and tool evidence into a fresh native thread; later model context is excluded. Returns the new chat snapshot. Does not undo or copy working directory changes.

post.summary: Delete a message and every later message in a replacement chat
post.description: Requires a terminal selected chat. Clears queued follow-ups and returns an independent replacement with a new chat ID and the original title immediately. The source disappears from lists and is durably queued for seven-pass erasure in the background; cleanup failures and service restarts are retried automatically. Use the returned chat ID for subsequent requests and event replay. Working directory changes and external actions are not undone. Retry the same submissionId to retrieve the same replacement, including after source erasure.
